class.name: SharePlayMultiplayerPeer
class.brief_description: A [MultiplayerPeer] implementation backed by SharePlay on visionOS.
class.description: Implements Godot's high-level multiplayer API on top of Apple's SharePlay and GroupActivities frameworks, letting players in the same FaceTime call share a Godot session without any game server. The peer that calls [method start_activity] becomes the server and is always assigned peer ID [code]1[/code]. Every other participant is assigned a generated peer ID as they join. Messages are delivered reliably and in order, so [method MultiplayerPeer.get_packet_mode] always reports [constant MultiplayerPeer.TRANSFER_MODE_RELIABLE]. [b]Note:[/b] This class is only available on visionOS, and requires an active FaceTime call to start a session. [codeblock] var peer = SharePlayMultiplayerPeer.new() peer.activity_title = "My Game" peer.start_activity() multiplayer.multiplayer_peer = peer [/codeblock]

method.name: end_activity
method.description: Ends the current SharePlay activity for the local participant and closes the peer. Does nothing if no activity is running.

method.name: start_activity
method.description: Starts a SharePlay activity and makes this peer the server, using [member activity_title] as the name shown in the system UI. Returns [constant OK] if the activity was requested, or [constant ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE] if an activity is already running. Because activation is asynchronous, [method MultiplayerPeer.get_connection_status] stays [constant MultiplayerPeer.CONNECTION_CONNECTING] until the system confirms the session.

members.member: The title shown in the system SharePlay UI for this activity. Set this before calling [method start_activity].
